findings.title: Verify the early 上 glyph variation against primary inscriptions
findings.details: The entry describes early 上 as a mark above a reference line and preserves accounts that call the line curved or horizontal. The cited book scan verifies what 字源 reports, but the underlying glyph witnesses and named inscriptional examples were not inspected. No artifact image in this research resolves the variation, so the prose appropriately leaves it open.
findings.verification: Inspect the exact cited editions and pages for the named oracle-bone and bronze witnesses, including the component strokes and context. Preserve the competing descriptions unless primary evidence resolves them; do not treat compound transcriptions such as 上甲 as isolating the character.
evidence: 字源 PDF page 14 / printed page 2
